The '''Cegul sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], rimward of [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
The sector neither was part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] at the time of its collapse,<ref name="TEA" /> nor of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Reconquest of the Rim]].<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> However, it was annexed by the Empire prior to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="EAOC" />
